notes.tom-blockade: wanstop-tom-blockade-r3: one change, pad 0.8 (the start picture is shrunk to 80 percent inside the frame). By eye both r3 videos do the move: arms out with open palms, a weight shift to the left, a hold, then back to the stance. The only measured fault in both is the right hand touching the right edge (video frames 29 to 33; 2 and 5 of 150 pictures). The look checks p1 to p3 said no on both, but the pictures show the moves; the checks may be strict about the palm pose and the hip, which is left for Tom's watch card. notes.rose-cast: wanch2: Kling r2 (pad 0.8) made the cast with no rings, but the outstretched hands left the left edge (this start picture fills the frame more than Grace's); one change: pad 0.65, as rose-tackle r4 that passed
notes.rose-tackle: wanch2: Kling r3 has one lamb (the Wan fault is gone) but her reaching hand left the left edge at the lunge; one change: pad 0.65 (was 0.8)
notes.rose-giddyup: wanch3: Kling r3 jumped two or three times. One change: the last sentence loses "she hops back to her spot and" (the second hop) (v2 prompt). Same model, picture, frame, pad. Result r4 (wanch3): one jump now, but the hair top is cut at the top of the jump and the waving hand leaves the left edge; next one change is pad 0.65. wanch4 r5: one change, pad 0.65 (was 0.8), the fix that passed rose-tackle r4 and the casts. Prompt v2 unchanged. Result r5 (wanch4): MISSED. The top edge is clear now (hair top at row 30), but the leap became a forward somersault, upside down at video frames 66 to 74, and her hair touches the left edge at frames 70 to 74. Edge miss twice in a row: stop-loss on pad. Cause: the prompt says feet planted on the same spot AND leaps up and forward to the left; the travel to the left plus the tuck turns into a tumble toward the left edge. Next one change (card c-wanch5): leaps straight up, pad stays 0.65. wanch5 r6: one change, v3 prompt = v2 with "leaps up and forward to the left once" changed to "leaps straight up once". Pad stays 0.65, airborne stays true. Bake settings from rose-tackle (rose-giddyup.js does not exist yet; the tackle is her other Kling strike at pad 0.65). Result r6 (bulk run 44967949648): STOPPED on the look checks p1 and p2; every measurement passed (edge clear, height 0.1 percent, ends 2.01). By eye: one straight-up jump with knees tucked and a clean return, but before it the word "twirls" became a full body spin: her back is to the camera at video frames 32 to 42, then she turns back and crouches. The spin is the extra motion the look check called inconsistent. wanstop r7: one change, v4 prompt = v3 with "twirls one hand above her head" changed to "circles one hand above her head". Kept: the rest of the prompt word for word, Kling 4.0, the start picture, 720x1280, 5 s, pad 0.65, airborne, bake and wire. Result r7 (bulk run 44971778287): STOPPED on bg and edge (measurements; look checks not run). By eye: the hand circle is right (no body spin now), but the cannonball became a backward somersault, upside down at video frame 54, and she lands with her arm flung out to the left. Both misses are that flip: the background spread over the limit is in frame 54 only (23.8, the blur of the upside-down figure; every other frame is under 15) and the left edge touches are frames 58 and 59, the landing. The jump sentence was the same in r6 (upright jump) and r7 (flip), and r5 also tumbled, so the tuck is free to turn into a flip. wanstop r8: one change, v5 prompt = v4 with "a tight cannonball" changed to "a tight upright cannonball". Kept: the rest of the prompt word for word, Kling 4.0, the start picture, 720x1280, 5 s, pad 0.65, airborne, bake and wire. wanauto1: fresh budget from auto_from (4 videos, $3.20); this rev runs without a tap. wanauto1: stop-loss after r8 (flip again, and a hoop drawn for "circles one hand"); Tom decides the move on t-giddyup-decide.
notes.deedee-cast: wanch2: Kling r2 (pad 0.8) made the cast with no rings, but the outstretched hands left the left edge (this start picture fills the frame more than Grace's); one change: pad 0.65, as rose-tackle r4 that passed
notes.deedee-wetfloor: wanch3: on Wan and on Kling r3 the mop head swept below her feet line; the words "in front of her feet" read as lower on the screen in this view. One change: "beside her feet, level with them" (v2 prompt). Same model, picture, frame, pad. Result r4 (wanch3): same miss a third time (mop head 114 px below the feet row) and two sweeps; stop-loss on wording. wanch5 r5: Tom answered t-wanch4-wetfloor "Yes, a mop drawn lower than her feet is fine if she sweeps once". One change: pad 0.65 (was 0.8), the fix that cleared the left edge on rose-tackle and the casts. Prompt v2 unchanged. Feet limit 0.10 (was 0.01): in this three-quarter view the mop head rests on the floor ahead of her and is drawn below her feet row; r4 measured 122 px, 9.5 percent of the frame height, at pad 0.8 (replay-checks). The other 4.4 checks hold. Bake settings from deedee-windex (deedee-wetfloor.js does not exist yet; Windex is her other move with shape cast). Result r5 (bulk run 44967949648): STOPPED on edge, p1, p2. The feet limit held (7.7 percent) and the left edge at the stance is clear; by eye she sweeps left, right, left, right, left (about five strokes, video frames 32 to 91) and the mop head touches the left or right edge at the end of each stroke: the 23 edge frames are exactly those stroke ends, and the repeated strokes are what p1 and p2 call unclear. wanstop r6: one change, v3 prompt = v2 with "in one wide sweep from right to left" changed to "in one short sweep from right to left" ("wide" asks for the reach that hits the edges). Kept: the rest of the prompt word for word, Kling 4.0, the start picture, 720x1280, 5 s, pad 0.65 (the last pad, so the Action has no edge retry left), feet limit 0.10, bake and wire. If it still strokes back and forth, the next one change is the sentence that says how many sweeps, not the width. Result r6 (bulk run 44971778287): STOPPED on the look checks p1 and p2; every measurement passed (edge clear now, feet 7.3 percent, ends 1.55). By eye: the short sweep fixed the edges, but she still strokes back and forth two or three times (video frames 36 to 90), and the mop shows up at her side instead of from behind her back. The look check named "behind her back" in r5 and r6 alike; that wording stays, because the mop has to leave the picture for the last picture to match the first (ends check) and her baked Windex and scrub use the same wording. wanstop r7: one change, the sweep sentence (as planned at r6): v4 prompt = v3 with ", the mop head staying on top of the floor the whole time" deleted. It asks for the mop on the floor for a long stretch, which is what the repeated strokes fill; it was there only to keep the mop above her feet, which Tom said is fine (11-21) and the feet limit 0.10 now allows. Kept: every other word of the prompt, Kling 4.0, the start picture, 720x1280, 5 s, pad 0.65, feet limit 0.10, bake and wire. wanauto1: fresh budget from auto_from (4 videos, $3.20); this rev runs without a tap. wanauto1: r7 baked by hand after a look at every frame (one sweep beside her feet, mop put away); the look check failed it only on "from behind her back". wanmop1 r8: Tom (19:48): "Deedee is using a broom not a mop." Right: r7 drew a flat push-broom head. One change: v5 = v4 with "a short mop" changed to "a short string mop with a floppy wet head". Everything else kept. Fresh budget. wanstop r9 (card c-wanstop-deedee-wetfloor-r8): the r8 string mop is right in both videos. Try 1 failed only bg (a pink floor shadow under the mop, 5.46 percent off colour); try 2 (same settings) looked right and failed feet by 0.2 point (10.2 percent, 2 pictures) and the left edge in 6 pictures (video frames 46 to 47 and 70 to 73), the mop head at the end of the sweep. One change: pad 0.55 (was 0.65), the next step down for the same edge and feet reach: a smaller figure leaves room at the left and puts the mop head fewer pixels below the feet row. Kept: prompt v5 word for word, Kling 4.0, start picture, 720x1280, 5 s, feet limit 0.10, bake and wire. Rev 9. movefun2 (Tom picked Fix all): one change, the last sentence only: after the sweep she sets a small yellow wet-floor sign beside her feet and wags one finger at it (was: mop behind her back). Kept: the sweep sentence word for word, Kling 4.0, start picture, 5 s, pad 0.55, feet limit 0.10, bake and wire. Plays at 1.25x (was 1.5x), about 4 s. Rev 10. wanstuck1: r9 baked by hand (a brown string mop, two short sweeps beside her feet, put away, back to her stance); the look check failed it on "once" and "from behind her back" only.
